description: This Java class implements an auto-discarding diagnostic logging adapter that wraps another logging adapter, automatically discarding MDC entries after each log operation.

classes.name: AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter that wraps another adapter and discards MDC entries after each log call.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message or throwable and discards MDC entries afterward.

methods.name: notifyWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message and discards MDC entries afterward.

methods.name: notifyInfo
methods.description: Logs an info message and discards MDC entries afterward.

methods.name: notifyDebug
methods.description: Logs a debug message and discards MDC entries afterward.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Retrieves the MDC as a Map.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets the MDC with a given Map.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry with a key and value.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logging adapter.
